content.rationale: IN-mechanism (lmomkluy) fixes the ordered bootstrap — create the git repository, append the state directory to `.git/info/exclude`, then create the jj workspace colocated with it — and this check drives `jj_init::bootstrap` over a scratch directory, pinning that a git repository is created, that `.deccy/` is appended to `.git/info/exclude` with git's own template preserved, and that a jj workspace is created colocated with it. The order is pinned by a jj binary that refuses unless the state directory is already recorded, so a workspace created first fails the gate; a crossing that exits non-zero or cannot spawn is pinned as a failure value, never a panic. It is self-contained per M-tests (knqkxzns), declaring the module and its code parents through `#[path]` shims, and crosses real jj and git processes (xmxpvqzs) under caller-supplied binaries and root (vyquqmoo), holding nothing (lvkukpyw), with failures surfacing as values (uzzxlpsl). It pins the record step's idempotence (IN-record-idempotent, vnsyvzpp) — a second run leaves a single `.deccy/` line — and that an exclude failure surfaces at the site S2-exclude-refusal-site (yuslrlov) names.
